description: A fashion company sells regular handbags and premium handbags made of higher quality material. They can sell regular handbags at a profit of $30 each and premium handbags at a profit of $180 each. The total monthly cost of manufacturing is $200 per regular handbag and $447 per premium handbag. The company has a total budget of $250000 and can sell at most 475 handbags of either type per month. How many of each handbag should they sell to maximize its monthly profit?

MaxHandbagsPerMonth.definition: Maximum number of handbags that can be sold per month

objective.description: "Maximize the total monthly profit from selling regular and premium handbags"

constraints.description: The total manufacturing cost of regular and premium handbags should not exceed the total budget of $250000
The total number of regular and premium handbags sold per month should not exceed 475
The numbers of regular and premium handbags sold should be non-negative

RegularHandbags.definition: Number of regular handbags sold per month

PremiumHandbags.definition: Number of premium handbags sold per month
